name: popsicle
headline: Twitter-Init-Kit - AI SaaS Twitter Marketing
short_description: Spec-driven Twitter marketing toolkit for AI SaaS launches. CLI + AI agent workflows with templates for campaigns, growth loops, and founder-led content. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf.
author: agentii-ai

sections.overview:
Twitter-Init-Kit is a specialized toolkit that applies spec-driven methodology to Twitter marketing and founder-led growth campaigns for AI SaaS products. It provides a CLI (`twitterify`) with AI agent workflows, templates, and structured processes for defining campaign specifications, planning execution, and managing growth loops. The toolkit works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and other AI coding agents through `/twitterkit.*` commands that guide users through specification, clarification, planning, and implementation phases. Built on Spec-Kit foundations, it helps founders and growth leads replace ad-hoc social media experimentation with systematic Twitter campaign workflows that track engagement, activation, retention, and virality metrics.
Launch AI coding tool on Twitter with structured campaign specs and growth loops
Plan 4-week Twitter campaigns targeting technical founders and Series A-C startups
Generate Twitter content calendars and demo-driven launch workflows with AI agents
Define campaign personas, objectives, and success metrics before execution
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/agentii-ai/twitter-init-kit`
sections.usage:
```
I'm launching a new AI SaaS product called [PRODUCT_NAME] in the [INDUSTRY] space. I need a Twitter marketing strategy to generate buzz and attract early adopters. Can you help me create a 30-day Twitter campaign plan using the Twitter-Init-Kit? Include specific tweet templates, engagement strategies, and growth loops tailored to our target audience of [TARGET_AUDIENCE].
```
Copy

```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
